newsitem.title: USA: Optical Cable sees 1999 sales of $137 mln.
newsitem.headline: Optical Cable sees 1999 sales of $137 mln.

text.p: Optical Cable Corp said on Tuesday it expects sales to double between 1997 and 1999, to $137 million, as its share of the fiber optic sensor market grows.
Optical Cable said it expects sales of $62.7 million in 1996, $91.5 million in 1998, and $136.8 million in 1999.
It could not immediately be determined whether the company was referring to its fiscal year or the calendar year.
For the first nine months of its fiscal year 1996, ended July 31, the company reported sales of $31.4 million.
Optical Cable said construction of a new facility is continuing on schedule for occupancy during December.

The doubling in size of its facility and the equipment expansion "will hardly affect earnings," Optical Cable said. The company said about $25,000 per quarter of additional amortization will show up, since amortization of present equipment is just about to expire.

"Our base business segments are projected to grow rapidly with increasing market share potential," the company said in a statement. "Many new market segments shall emerge as fiber optic sensors are developed for production plant automation, smart highways, security applications, along with a host of other specialty markets."
